ethnicity_note: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), Macao SAR, Detailed Results of 2021 Population Census (revised version, October 2022), Table 6: population by nationality, both sexes, of the 682,070 people counted in August 2021. Nationality, not ethnicity: the census's ethnicity table (Table 7) folds every people but the Chinese and Portuguese into one 'Others', so the nationality table, which names the Filipinos, is carried and labelled for what it is. 'Other Asian nationality' is the census's 'Other Asian countries', within which its text puts Vietnamese nationals at 1.8% of the population.
language_basis: usual language, population aged 3 and over
language_note: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), Macao SAR, Detailed Results of 2021 Population Census (revised version, October 2022), Table 10: usual language, both sexes, of the 663,782 people aged 3 and over. Usual language is the one language a person mostly uses at home; 'Other languages' is the census's 'Others'.
